description.value: Trench Brewing & Distilling is a craft brewery and distillery in Prince George whose entire identity is rooted in the Rocky Mountain Trench — every beer named after a local natural landmark. The taproom pairs a rotating lineup of flagship and small-batch pilot brews with a food menu built around house-smoked meats and gourmet tacos, making it a substantial sit-down stop. Beers can also be purchased to take home, and the brewery distributes widely across BC.
